blocking_findings.finding: The runner invokes validate_source before consume-attempt. validate_source invokes M785.verify_sealed_directory on the M699 payload, whose implementation opens and hashes every sealed member. Therefore real bitpacks are opened before the canonical attempt is consumed, contradicting the release contract and runner comment.
blocking_findings.reproduction: The independent hammer replaces only the payload verifier with a tripwire. validate_source reaches it exactly once while the canonical attempt remains absent; the hammer opens no real payload member.
blocking_findings.required_repair: Split metadata/seal identity validation from payload-member verification. Consume the canonical attempt before the first full payload-member verification/open, then verify members inside the consumed attempt. Freeze and hammer the new ordering.

blocking_findings.finding: assemble validates only schemas, raw SHA, mismatch zero, D1 false, and top-level claim flags. It does not recursively validate raw windows, coverage, CI envelopes, status, pair role, exact identities, transaction conservation, or forbidden semantic point fields.
blocking_findings.reproduction: A synthetic post-run work directory containing candidate_mean_cycles and point_speedup, a forged status/RUN_COMPLETE, and a correspondingly updated raw SHA is accepted and double-sealed by assemble without any cycle replay.
blocking_findings.required_repair: Add a strict exact-key result/raw validator that recomputes and binds every layer/window identity and invokes M1041 strong-typed CI validation before sealing. Reject semantic point aliases at arbitrary depth outside the approved publication envelope.

blocking_findings.finding: contract_value binds the selected D0/D2/D3 workload and false claim flags but does not validate the D1 object or reject extra semantic fields. A caller-followed modified contract SHA can relabel D1 as scheduled and add candidate means/speedup fields while parsing successfully.
blocking_findings.required_repair: Use exact-key recursive contract validation, bind D1 diagnostic-only semantics explicitly, and pin the exact repaired contract SHA in the independent authority.
